name: SEED
description: EEG dataset for emotion/affective-state research. 15 subjects watching 15 movie clips (5 positive, 5 negative, 5 neutral) across 3 sessions. 62-channel EEG at 200 Hz. Per-trial valence/arousal/dominance ratings (1-9 scale) and NASA-TLX workload scores provided in annotation CSV files.

nasa_tlx_workload.description: NASA-TLX workload score (when available in annotation files)

preprocessing_requirements.note: SEED valence/arousal/dominance ratings are genuine self-report labels but are emotional-state ratings, not direct workload scores. NASA-TLX scores are the gold standard for workload. The weighted combination (0.6×arousal + 0.2×valence + 0.2×dominance) is a derivation, not ground truth, for the cognitive workload task.

scientific_status: GROUNDED_TRUTH for emotional_state_classification — valence/arousal/dominance are genuine self-report labels. NOT GROUNDED for workload — derived combination is a proxy, not direct NASA-TLX measurement.
label_derivation: Ratings collected via 9-point Likert scale immediately after each movie clip. NASA-TLX workload scores collected via validated questionnaire. The weighted combination (0.6×arousal + 0.2×valence + 0.2×dominance) is a derivation, not ground truth for workload.
circularity_risk: NONE — labels are self-reported, not computed from EEG features
